articles.title: AI helps pathologists find signs of preeclampsia, advancing diagnosis and treatment
articles.excerpt: Preeclampsia is one of the leading causes of pregnancy-related death. Even after a healthy delivery, mother and baby can go home only to show signs of a postpartum hypertensive disorder days or weeks later.
articles.summary: AI辅助病理学家识别子痫前期征象，以推进诊断和治疗；子痫前期是妊娠相关死亡的主要原因之一，产后高血压疾病可在顺利分娩后数天至数周出现。
